name: io.github.hammasbuilds/repo-recon
title: Repo Recon
description: Read an unfamiliar Python codebase from its AST: structure, impact, modernisation risk, release readiness. Writes nothing; the two git-history tools run `git log` and `git diff`, and nothing else is executed.

environmentVariables.name: REPO_RECON_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: A directory every path argument must sit under. Optional, and worth setting: a filesystem path is this server's only input, so this is the one thing worth bounding. Without it, any readable path on the machine can be analysed.
